# Flows: BookShelf

One flowchart per flow in `profile.json`. All flows are inferred from controller redirects and views (see `assumptions`). Decision nodes marked with a comment are proposed behavior that the code does not implement yet.

## register

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    open-register["Open Register (account-register)"] --> submit["Submit email and password<br/>POST /account/register"]
    submit --> login["Redirect to Login (account-login)"]
```

## sign-in

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    open-login["Open Login (account-login)"] --> submit["Submit email and password<br/>POST /account/login"]
    %% ASSUMPTION: credential check is the intended behavior; the code currently skips it (TODO in AccountController)
    submit --> valid{"Credentials valid?"}
    valid -->|"yes"| books["My Books (books-index)"]
    valid -->|"no"| error["Stay on Login and show an error"]
    error --> open-login
```

## add-book

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    open-index["My Books (books-index)"] --> open-create["Add a Book (books-create)<br/>GET /books/create"]
    open-create --> submit["Submit title, author and ISBN<br/>POST /books/create"]
    submit --> back["Redirect to My Books"]
```

## delete-book

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    open-index["My Books (books-index)"] --> open-details["Book Details (books-details)<br/>GET /books/{id}"]
    open-details --> delete["Choose Delete<br/>POST /books/{id}/delete"]
    delete --> back["Redirect to My Books"]
```
